prose.name: Recovery: Courier's Files over <Planet>
prose.briefing: Raiders hit a government courier over <Planet> and left her crippled with their own crew aboard. The courier's office wants its files back before anyone reads them.
prose.card: Our courier was hit over <Planet>. The raiders are still aboard, with friends outside. Get our files off that ship.

broadcast: That's our courier, and those aren't our people aboard her. Deal with whatever's flying cover, then get inside and bring the files out. I'd rather nobody read them first.
